verdicts.check: go test -count=1 ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestHandlerRobotsTXT -v in the solo-judge scratch tree
verdicts.tldr: under -no-index robots.txt drops the Disallow for /search.json and /status.json, the two node-querying JSON endpoints, though neither carries a page whose noindex a crawler must see
verdicts.details: crawl.go:31 assigns the body outright instead of appending Allow to the default, so a -no-index deployment invites crawlers onto /search.json (two vm/qpaths queries) and /status.json (a node status query). The test's rationale 'A Disallow would hide the noindex header' holds for pages; a JSON endpoint is never indexed. Not a regression: the merge base served no robots.txt.

Disallow: /status.json
"', :31 'body = "# Not indexed: ...

Allow: /
"'; TestHandlerRobotsTXT/noindex_still_allows_crawling PASS pins that body (crawl_test.go:47)
